rules.category: technique => skills; path[0] はじめての将棋 => basics; path[0] 戦法、定跡 or 戦法・定跡 => joseki; other path => skills; no path => joseki
rules.group: technique: tesuji/sabaki => 手筋, kuzushi => 囲い崩し; otherwise path[0] 囲い => 囲い; otherwise final path element; then PATH_GROUP rename
rules.josekiGroup: Opening path with >1 element => groupOf; opening path with only root => 戦法、定跡; other setups => undefined
rules.josekiRendering: Selected main strategy supplies STRATEGY_GROUP. Lessons with that group appear with its ideas/tactics; matchup setups whose main equals selection appear separately. Opening lesson groups absent from all selector mappings appear in shared other groups.
rules.visibility: OpeningPicker all includes setup when courses.length>0 or setup.path exists. Non-joseki fixed headings render only when entries exist.
rules.counts: sourceUnitCount counts distinct data/lessons/units/*.json metadata; does not count legacy matchup/technique setup cards, courses, mirrored perspectives or chapters.
